name: NecronomiCon Providence
blurb: A biennial international conference and festival of weird fiction, art and academia centered on H.P. Lovecraft, held in Providence, Rhode Island.
notes: Biennial, confirming the batch note; the 'next edition Aug 2026' it referred to already happened (Aug 13-16, 2026, per the Guests of Honor 2026 page: 'August 13-16, 2026 #NecronomiConPVD Brought to you by the Lovecraft Arts & Sciences Council'), and that is before today (2026-10-05), so it is recorded as 'last' rather than an upcoming edition. No 2028 dates (the expected next biennial edition) have been announced anywhere on the site yet. Registration/venue per the Passes and Tickets page: 'Registration during the convention will take place at the GRADUATE Hotel' with nearby events at the Omni and 'surrounding venues'. The homepage itself (necronomicon-providence.com) redirects to a minimal '/enter/' splash page, so dated content was read from the site's current (non-year-suffixed) Guests of Honor page instead; its many archive links (2013/2015/2017/2019/2024) are past editions, not this one.
